a.description: array-like object, or any object with a ``size`` attribute when ``axis`` is not specified, or with a ``shape`` attribute when ``axis`` is specified.
constraints: input parameter `a` must have a size or shape attribute if `axis` is specified

axis.description: optional integer or sequence of integers indicating which axis or axes to count elements along. ``None`` (the default) returns the total number of elements.
constraints: input parameter `a` must have a size or shape attribute if `axis` is specified
if `axis` is not None, it should be an integer or sequence of integers within input rank

output.description: An integer specifying the number of elements in ``a``.

constraints: input parameter `a` must have a size or shape attribute if `axis` is specified
